title: Prince Harry's return in the United Kingdom could mean problems for the monarchy amid Trump's scathing comments
text:
Prince Harry’s potential return to the United Kingdom could create more problems for the monarchy, warned a real source, after the controversial comments of former US president Donald Trump about his deportation. According GB news The source suggested that Harry’s presence in Britain would be more harmful to the royal family than his current residence in the United States.

“Having it in the United Kingdom is really more difficult than staying away in the United States,” said the source, emphasizing concerns about renewed tensions within the Royal Home. Trump, who has expressed his views on the Duke and the Duchess of Sussex, recently intervened in the subject, making a forceful comment about Harry’s possible deportation.
“I will leave it alone. He has enough problems with his wife. She is terrible “Trump said, referring to Meghan Markle. In his relationship, Trump added:” I think poor Harry is being driven by the nose. “His comments have caused a greater debate about the position of the Sussexes both in the United Kingdom and in the United States, as well as its continuous departure from the royal family.
The real expert, Angela Levin, responded to Trump’s statements, claiming that the former president’s position aligns with the opinions of the Senior Royals. “He respects King Charles and doesn’t want to bother him during his fight against cancer.” Levin said . “It also admires Prince William, whom he knows he wants to have anything to do with his brother. Or Meghan. DIANA.”
(Photo of Ethan Cairns/Getty Images) Trump also praised Prince William, describing him as an exemplary real figure. “I think William is a great young man,” he said, even more highlighting the division between the future king and his younger brother.

The potential impact of Harry’s return remains a subject of speculation. While some believe that their presence could help repair fractured relationships, others argue that their return would only revive tensions within the royal family, particularly given their tense relationship with their father, King Carlos and the brother, Prince William.
With Trump’s comments adding another layer of controversy to the situation of Harry, the Duke of Sussex continues to sail for a complex relationship with the monarchy and political climate in the United States as questions about his delayed future, the royal family faces the challenge to manage another more public show that surrounds the Sussexes.
